$comment: omapilot PLANES profile. lapis: when OMAPILOT_OVERLAY_VAULT is set it is passed as `--vault <path>` (host overlay of allowlisted live files); when UNSET no --vault is passed — never Atrium-as-overlay, no Atrium default. hedron: G5a one-tool read-only hql shim. omapi stdio spawn does not expand ${ENV} in argv, so the shim is started via sh -c (same as lapis) so $OMAPI_REPO expands in the shell. Unset OMAPI_REPO fails visible; HEDRON_DB is inherited from the omapi process environment when exported.

args: if [ -n "$OMAPILOT_OVERLAY_VAULT" ]; then exec lapis mcp --vault "$OMAPILOT_OVERLAY_VAULT"; else exec lapis mcp; fi

if [ -z "$OMAPI_REPO" ]; then echo 'OMAPI_REPO is unset; cannot start hedron hql shim' >&2; exit 1; fi; BUN="${OMAPI_BUN:-}"; if [ -z "$BUN" ]; then BUN=$(command -v bun 2>/dev/null || true); fi; if [ -z "$BUN" ] && [ -x /opt/homebrew/bin/bun ]; then BUN=/opt/homebrew/bin/bun; fi; if [ -z "$BUN" ]; then echo 'bun not found on PATH; set OMAPI_BUN' >&2; exit 1; fi; exec "$BUN" run "$OMAPI_REPO/packages/coding-agent/src/mcp/hedron-hql-stdio.ts"
